national.title: How to Link PAN with Aadhaar Online (2026)
national.summary: Step-by-step guide to linking your PAN with Aadhaar on the official Income Tax e-filing portal. Verified statutory fee of ₹1,000 under Section 234H, exemption categories, and biometric matching rules.

steps.title: Open Income Tax e-Filing Portal and Click 'Link Aadhaar'
steps.description: Visit incometax.gov.in and click 'Link Aadhaar' under Quick Links on the homepage.
steps.officialLinkLabel: Open Income Tax Link Aadhaar Portal
steps.calloutText: You can link your PAN and Aadhaar directly from the homepage without logging into an account.

steps.title: Enter 10-Digit PAN and 12-Digit Aadhaar Number
steps.description: Type your permanent account number and Aadhaar number to verify current linkage status.
steps.calloutText: Residents of Assam, Meghalaya, and J&K, non-citizens, and citizens aged 80+ are legally exempt from penalty.

steps.title: Pay Statutory Penalty Fee of ₹1,000 via e-Pay Tax
steps.description: Select Assessment Year and choose Major Head 0021 and Minor Head 500 (Fee for delay in linking PAN-Aadhaar).
steps.calloutText: Payment must be made under Minor Head 500 (Other Receipts) for delayed PAN-Aadhaar linkage.

steps.title: Wait for Payment Challan Realization (24 to 48 Hours)
steps.description: Wait until the e-Pay Tax challan reflects in the Income Tax database before submitting the final linkage request.

steps.title: Re-open 'Link Aadhaar' After Payment Clears
steps.description: Re-enter your PAN and Aadhaar number. The portal will display 'Your payment details are verified'.

steps.title: Enter Name and Mobile Number Exactly as on Aadhaar
steps.description: Enter your full name and mobile number. Tick 'I agree to validate my Aadhaar details'.

steps.title: Authenticate via Aadhaar 6-Digit OTP
steps.description: Enter the one-time password sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile number and click Validate.

steps.title: Track Linkage Request and Confirm Operative Status
steps.description: Check status under 'Link Aadhaar Status' using PAN and Aadhaar to confirm your PAN is fully operative.

rejectionReasons.title: Name Spelling Mismatch Between PAN and Aadhaar
rejectionReasons.description: If your name on the PAN card differs from the Aadhaar card, the automated matching algorithm fails.
rejectionReasons.solution: Correct the spelling on either PAN or Aadhaar to match before linking, or visit an authorized centre for biometric linkage.

rejectionReasons.title: Date of Birth or Gender Mismatch in Records
rejectionReasons.description: A discrepancy in the date of birth or recorded gender prevents automated database synchronization.
rejectionReasons.solution: Update your date of birth on the myAadhaar portal or submit a PAN correction Form CSF.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting Linkage Request Before Payment Realization
rejectionReasons.description: Attempting to link immediately after paying ₹1,000 before the bank challan clears in the tax database causes an error.
rejectionReasons.solution: Wait 24 to 48 hours after payment until the portal shows 'Your payment details are verified'.

rejectionReasons.title: Inoperative PAN with Mismatched Mobile Number
rejectionReasons.description: Unable to receive the 6-digit OTP because the Aadhaar registered mobile number is inactive or changed.
rejectionReasons.solution: Update your mobile number at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra before initiating the link request.

rejectionReasons.title: Attempting to Link Cancelled or Duplicate PAN
rejectionReasons.description: If you hold more than one PAN and attempt to link an inactive or deactivated number, the request fails.
rejectionReasons.solution: Surrender the duplicate PAN and link your genuine operative permanent account number.

rejectionReasons.title: Entering Incorrect Challan Minor Head Code
rejectionReasons.description: Selecting an incorrect head code instead of Minor Head 500 (Fee for delay in linking PAN-Aadhaar) invalidates the payment.
rejectionReasons.solution: Select Major Head 0021 and Minor Head 500 strictly under the e-Pay Tax payment menu.

faqItems.question: What is the penalty fee for linking PAN with Aadhaar?
faqItems.answer: The statutory penalty is ₹1,000 under Section 234H of the Income Tax Act paid via the e-Pay Tax service.

faqItems.question: What happens if I do not link my PAN with Aadhaar?
faqItems.answer: Your PAN becomes inoperative, leading to higher TDS/TCS deduction at 20% and inability to claim income tax refunds.

faqItems.question: Who is legally exempt from linking PAN with Aadhaar?
faqItems.answer: Residents of Assam, Meghalaya, and J&K, non-residents, non-citizens, and citizens aged 80 years or older are exempt.

faqItems.question: How long does it take for PAN to become operative after paying ₹1,000?
faqItems.answer: Payment confirmation takes 24 to 48 hours, and the PAN becomes operative within 30 days of submitting the link request.

faqItems.question: What should I do if my name spelling differs between PAN and Aadhaar?
faqItems.answer: Update the spelling on your PAN or Aadhaar first, or visit an authorized centre for biometric authentication linkage.

faqItems.question: Can I link PAN with Aadhaar if my mobile number is not linked to Aadhaar?
faqItems.answer: No. Online linkage requires OTP validation sent to the mobile number registered with UIDAI.

faqItems.question: How can I verify whether my PAN and Aadhaar are already linked?
faqItems.answer: Click 'Link Aadhaar Status' on incometax.gov.in, enter your PAN and Aadhaar, and view instant confirmation.

faqItems.question: Can I get a refund of the ₹1,000 fee if I made an error during payment?
faqItems.answer: No. Statutory fees paid under Section 234H are non-refundable by the Income Tax Department.
